title: Engram settings change skips the post-fence queue drain when MCP cleanup is degraded or pending, stranding prompts queued during the fence
outcome: After a project's connection fence is released, every session's queue is drained (best effort) whatever the cleanup outcome, so no automatic prompt queued during the fence is stranded.
acceptance: update_project_engram_settings_checked (src/session_crud.rs) always runs the per-session post-fence drain, collecting errors, before returning any cleanup error or pending-cleanup conflict, and one session's drain or delivery error no longer abandons the later sessions (or the fence release itself wakes the affected sessions' drains).

A regression test: Engram is disabled while one session's revocation is pending; another idle session that received a mailbox wake or delegation result during the fence starts its queued prompt without an unrelated user send or Resume.

completion.summary: Landed best-effort post-fence queue draining before cleanup errors or pending-Stop conflicts; all later sessions are attempted even if preparation or delivery fails. Added real mailbox delivery regressions. Fresh independent evaluation 92c86dd71c1c417db95a3a3ac9668224 passed both criteria on clean landed eb78d349.
